svg.title: A strategy proposes its next setting and cannot adopt it: one real run
svg.desc: RSI on 2026-10-12, in five numbered steps. One: the declared grid of six look-back lengths and two ways of reading the number, twelve settings, every one tried; the row today uses 14 sessions read as a rebound and the search picks 28 sessions read as strength continuing. Two: a gate judges the best of them on five checks, all passed. Three: second opinions, after trading costs and on the statistics alone, do not object. Four: the verdict is written to the ledger twice, a candidate on all 28 names and refused on the 16 whose prices the provider confirmed as adjusted, because its range crosses zero. Five: registration starts scoring on later sessions only, none of the 60 it needs scored yet, and the row keeps its setting until a person reviews an edit.

text.tspan: CLAWOCK · A STRATEGY THAT SEARCHES ITSELF
It may propose its next setting. It cannot adopt it.
One real search, drawn from the ledger: RSI on 2026-10-12, 28 names, Goldwind among them.
01 · IT TRIES ONLY WHAT WAS DECLARED
the row today: 14 sessions, read as a rebound
the search picks: 28 sessions, read as strength continuing
Twelve settings, declared before the search. All twelve are
counted, so a lucky one cannot pass as the only one tried.
02 · A GATE JUDGES THE BEST OF THEM
days it was not tuned on
A configuration line can make this gate
stricter, never looser than the code’s floor.
They can block. They cannot pass
On the 16 confirmed names, Goldwind among them, the search is refused:
its range crosses zero. The result leans on the other 12.
05 · THEN IT HAS TO KEEP WORKING
Scored only on days that had not happened
0 of 60 later sessions scored · nothing proposed yet
After 60 later sessions, and only if it passes the check it fails today,
the lab may propose an edit to the row. It cannot make one.
A search is a result about the past: it places no order and changes no live setting.
